title: La Vainilla de Papantla, MEXI TV
comment: vainilla-papantla (MEXITV): beneficio de vainilla en Papantla, Veracruz. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.SEVERIANO_OLARTE: Mexican man from Veracruz, vanilla patron, 66 years old, heavy-set, dark-brown skin, short white hair, a thick white mustache, a white long-sleeve linen shirt, a dark-brown leather vest, a silver ring, dark trousers, brown boots, his hands empty.
chars.CHAVA_ROSAS: Mexican man from Veracruz, 42 years old, strong, brown skin, curly black hair, a short black beard, a light-grey work shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a red bandana tied around his neck, dark-green cargo trousers, work boots, his hands empty.
chars.INES_OLARTE: Mexican woman from Veracruz, 58 years old, brown skin, grey hair in a braided crown, gold earrings, a white embroidered blouse with a white lace cape over the shoulders, a long navy-blue skirt, her hands empty.
chars.FERMIN_ALDANA: Mexican man, 62 years old, tall and thin, light skin, dyed black slicked-back hair, a thin black mustache, a black western shirt with silver embroidery, a white straw cowboy hat, a silver belt buckle, black jeans, black boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_BENEFICIO: Open-sided vanilla curing house in Papantla, Veracruz, in the humid golden afternoon: long wooden tables and racks with dark-brown vanilla pods drying on woven palm mats, a red tiled roof on thick wooden posts, a dirt yard beyond with lush green tropical vegetation and banana plants, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
